utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still haven’t got it on my list—where did you last see the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s at the community center now, on Sunday — Cleo moved it there. I still need a few more helpers, and any extra tools or screws would be great if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note the community center for Sunday. I can help look for a few more helpers and see if I have any spare tools or screws.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli. I could use help setting out tools and checking who still needs supplies on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can do that—I'll be at the front porch Saturday to set out tools and check supplies.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Eli. I really appreciate it—see you Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m coordinating the school pickup side of it, so I’m free after 3:30. What do you need me to handle at the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye — could you help me sort tools and keep an eye on any extra screws after 3:30? We’re set for Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I can sort tools and keep track of extra screws after 3:30 on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly the little porch fixes and a few loose chairs still need attention. We’re meeting this Saturday at the front porch, and any help you can spare would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Oren, quick update — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. Let me know if you can help or bring any tools or supplies.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks for the update, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works for me. I can help and bring a few basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what time on Saturday and the exact spot at the front porch? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I’m a bit swamped and don’t want to guess—can you send me the exact time and spot? I can still bring the hammer and screwdriver by then.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have the exact time or spot yet either, so let’s wait until you confirm them. Once you do, I’ll help spread the word and make sure it’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It’s this Saturday on the front porch. If you can spread the word, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word and keep folks updated about the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Mara — that’d help a lot. Let me know if you need any tools or details for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll check the notice so I can pass along the exact spot when I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — thanks, Noah. I’ll keep telling folks it’s this Sunday at the community center for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—this Sunday at the community center. I’ll make sure I pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Still need a few more tools and spare parts, plus help sorting them on Saturday. I’ll check the list by the front steps again.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, that means the repair drive is still on for Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, still on for Saturday at the front porch. I just need a few more tools, spare parts, and some help sorting them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rey — I’m still pulling the repair-drive details together for Saturday at the front porch, and I’ll let you know what needs fixing as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it—just let me know when you’ve got the list, and I’ll bring the screws on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’m still gathering the repair-drive list for Saturday at the front porch, and I’ll let you know what needs fixing as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help however you need—what should I bring or set up for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Dane—please bring tools if you have them and help set up the front porch. I still need a couple more helpers, too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I’ll bring what tools I can and help set up on the front porch Saturday. If anyone else needs a hand, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira—I really appreciate you keeping an ear out for the repair drive. If you hear of anyone who can help this Saturday, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You bet, Nell — I’ll spread the word and let you know if I hear of anyone who can lend a hand this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. I’ll keep an ear out too, and just let me know if you hear anything on who can help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center works, but I’m still waiting on the final timing and drop-off details before I can confirm helpers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll wait on the final timing and drop-off details before I confirm anything. Just send them over when you have them, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’ll send the final timing and drop-off spot as soon as I have them. Appreciate you helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, I’ll spread the word that it’s this Sunday at the community center for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Quinn — that’s really helpful. I’ll be at the community center on Sunday, and I can still use a few more tools and screws if you hear of any.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out for tools and screws and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m checking the list by the front steps again, then I’ll know exactly what still needs to be brought for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo — I’m pretty sure we still need a few tools and some extra hands for Saturday. Let me know what’s missing once you check the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll check the list and send you the missing tools and helper needs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I last saw the repair drive notes by the front steps, and it’s still set for Saturday at the front porch. Do you want me to check that spot again?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes please, that’d be lovely—if you spot the notes again, send them my way. I’m still gathering helpers for Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—I’ll check the front steps again and bring the notes to you if I find them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s at my front porch this Saturday, and we could really use a few extra hands for the repair drive. If you’re free, I’d appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help for a bit this Saturday — what should I grab or do when I get to the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Dane — if you can bring a hammer or screwdriver, that’d be great, and we can put you on sorting and small fixes when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira — I could use help sorting tools and making a quick list of what’s still missing. If you’re free, come by the front porch Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can do that — I’ll swing by Saturday morning and help sort the tools and make the missing list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Ira — thank you. I’ll have everything ready on the front porch Saturday morning, and we can make the list together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa — it’s on Sunday now at the community center, and I could still use a few more tools and screws if you have any to spare.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got a few extra tools and screws I can bring by. Thanks, Sam — I’m glad you’re on it for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s great, Rosa — thank you. I really appreciate you bringing them by for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the repair drive is this Saturday at the front porch. I can bring a few tools and help set up if that still works.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, that still works — thanks, Noah. I’ll let everyone know you’re bringing tools and helping set up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, just let me know if you need anything else from me before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — I’ve got the community hall on Pine Street for 6, and I’ll bring the tools, tape, and batteries.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Hana — the repair drive is on my front porch this Saturday, and your tools, tape, and batteries will be a big help. See you around 6!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’ll be there around 6 this Saturday with the tools, tape, and batteries. I’m just confirming: it’s your front porch, right?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening this Saturday at the front porch, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, that’s right — this Saturday at the front porch. I still could use a few more tools and screws if you’ve got any to spare.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still on for this Saturday at the front porch, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a bit unsure on the exact drop-off details, but I’ll pass along any updates as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll swing by the repair drive spot soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Bo — that’d help. I’m still waiting on the exact drop-off spot, so please keep an eye out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive, but I’m keeping an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—if you hear anything, let me know. I still need the exact list of repairs so I can line up helpers.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, I’ll pass along anything I hear about the repair list and helpers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s this Saturday on the front porch, and I still need a few helpers. If you can, please tell people to stop by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that. I’ll tell people to stop by and help on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Rey — I really appreciate it. If anyone asks, just send them my way and I’ll fill them in.
